#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const long long INF = (long long)1e18 + 1;

long long C[100][100];

struct State {
    int x, y, side;
    long long dist;
    State(int x_, int y_, int side_, long long dist_) : x(x_), y(y_), side(side_), dist(dist_) {}
};

long long multiply(long long base, int n1, int r1, int n2, int r2) {
    base = (base * C[n1][r1]) % MOD;
    base = (base * C[n2][r2]) % MOD;
    return base;
}

int main() {
    // Build Pascal's triangle
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j] + C[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    int N, capacity;
    cin >> N >> capacity;
    
    int groupA = 0, groupB = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        int val;
        cin >> val;
        if (val == 50) groupA++;
        else groupB++;
    }

    long long minDist[200][200][2];
    long long numWays[200][200][2];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
            minDist[i][j][0] = INF;
            minDist[i][j][1] = INF;
            numWays[i][j][0] = 0;
            numWays[i][j][1] = 0;
        }
    }

    minDist[0][0][0] = 0;
    numWays[0][0][0] = 1;

    deque<State> deque;
    deque.push_back(State(0, 0, 0, 0));

    while (!deque.empty()) {
        State s = deque.front();
        deque.pop_front();
        int x = s.x;
        int y = s.y;
        int side = s.side;
        long long d = minDist[x][y][side];

        if (side == 0) {
            int remainingA = groupA - x;
            int remainingB = groupB - y;
            for (int takeA = 0; takeA <= remainingA; takeA++) {
                for (int takeB = 0; takeB <= remainingB; takeB++) {
                    if (takeA == 0 && takeB == 0) continue;
                    int weight = takeA * 50 + takeB * 100;
                    if (weight > capacity) break;
                    int nx = x + takeA;
                    int ny = y + takeB;
                    int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                    if (minDist[nx][ny][nextSide] >= d + 1) {
                        if (minDist[nx][ny][nextSide] > d + 1) {
                            minDist[nx][ny][nextSide] = d + 1;
                            deque.push_back(State(nx, ny, nextSide, d + 1));
                            numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] = (numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] + multiply(numWays[x][y][side], remainingA, takeA, remainingB, takeB)) % MOD;
                        } else {
                            numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] = (numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] + multiply(numWays[x][y][side], remainingA, takeA, remainingB, takeB)) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int remainingA = x;
            int remainingB = y;
            for (int takeA = 0; takeA <= remainingA; takeA++) {
                for (int takeB = 0; takeB <= remainingB; takeB++) {
                    if (takeA == 0 && takeB == 0) continue;
                    int weight = takeA * 50 + takeB * 100;
                    if (weight > capacity) break;
                    int nx = x - takeA;
                    int ny = y - takeB;
                    int nextSide = side ^ 1;
                    if (minDist[nx][ny][nextSide] >= d + 1) {
                        if (minDist[nx][ny][nextSide] > d + 1) {
                            minDist[nx][ny][nextSide] = d + 1;
                            deque.push_back(State(nx, ny, nextSide, d + 1));
                            numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] = (numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] + multiply(numWays[x][y][side], remainingA, takeA, remainingB, takeB)) % MOD;
                        } else {
                            numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] = (numWays[nx][ny][nextSide] + multiply(numWays[x][y][side], remainingA, takeA, remainingB, takeB)) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (minDist[groupA][groupB][1] == INF) {
        cout << -1 << endl;
    } else {
        cout << minDist[groupA][groupB][1] << endl;
    }
    cout << numWays[groupA][groupB][1] << endl;

    return 0;
}
